authoritative_for: Iatreion owns validation, joining, deterministic classification, and presentation of one bounded operational report over a selected Cell checkout.
not_authoritative_for: Cell declarations identify expected products and units; Usher interprets their form; Chancery owns installed documentation; Clockwork owns schedules and runtime activations; Nucleus owns agent execution; each product owns domain state and success.

covers: Operational report and unit inspection, stateless installation, and Iatreion development.
excludes: Monitoring history, alerting, repairs, retries, canaries, network readiness, model work, and product operation.

shared_access_and_trust: Iatreion reads one selected checkout and directly invokes declared selector basenames under one selected installed command directory with fixed status-snapshot arguments.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Reports contain bounded operational metadata and no probe stderr, logs, prompts, credentials, email bodies, or retained document bodies. Iatreion retains no report.

CLI dispatch separately attempts a metadata-only Chancery usage append (system, command, optional Codex thread and observation time). Recording errors preserve product results; no arguments or output are retained. Registration is a separate --register-usage installation step.
compatibility_and_retirement: Product release, status schema, report schema, and capability contract version evolve independently. Unknown versions remain visible and are not interpreted.
operational_limits: The default report budget is five seconds, each probe budget is two seconds, concurrency is eight, and captured stdout or stderr is limited to one MiB per probe.
